name: Andaz Xintiandi
positioning: Andaz Xintiandi, Shanghai: the first Andaz hotel in Asia, a contemporary Hyatt lifestyle hotel on Songshan Road with views over Xintiandi
best_for: Travelers who want a contemporary Shanghai base with views of Xintiandi
Guests looking for a bi-level suite or penthouse with a full kitchen

facts.text: Andaz Xintiandi, Shanghai was the first hotel of the Andaz brand to launch in Asia.
The Andaz name means 'personal style' in Hindi.
The hotel is at 88 Songshan Road, Shanghai.
All rooms are non-smoking and feature contemporary decor and mood lighting.
Rooms have heated floors in the bathroom.
Rooms have an iPad-based guestroom solution.
The Andaz Loft King is a residential-like bi-level suite with a separate lounge and a Typhoon shower.
The Andaz XL Suite is a bi-level suite highlighting traditional craftsmanship with modern touches, with a separate lounge and an intimate dining area.
The Andaz Suite has a private office with a large desk.
The hotel has a pool, a fitness center and a spa.
Bleu Bar, designed by the Japanese design firm Tofu Inc., has seats inside and on a terrace.
Kitchen Studios is rooted in Shanghai style and brings together international cuisines.

highlights.text: The Penthouse Garden suite has a rooftop garden with sun beds and a hot tub.
The Penthouse Retreat is a spa suite with an oversized bathtub and a massage table for in-room spa treatments.
The Penthouse Skyview suite looks down on Xintiandi and Huai Hai Road and has a full kitchen.
The King Bed with Xintiandi View room offers views of Xintiandi, with a separate sitting area.
88 Sushi Bento Bar is a Japanese restaurant tucked in a steel cocoon above the Andaz Lounge.

considerations.text: The hotel does not allow pets except for service animals.
Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is 8.7 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may bring city noise and a bustling atmosphere.
